## W14 Evidence register and decision pack

W14   Workflow ID __________   Version/date __________   Status __________

Prepared by __________   Accountable owner __________   Evidence location __________

Done when: every claim, control, test and decision in the decision pack links to an evidence ID with a status; overdue requests have owners; and the system of record and access rules are stated.

Source basis: [GRC Workbook](https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) · [AI Impact Assessment Tool](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-Impact-Assessment-Tool) · [AI GRC Copilot](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-GRC-Copilot)

Requested means sought but absent. Provided means received but not validated. Verified means a named competent person checked relevance, sufficiency and integrity for the stated claim. Not verified means the check failed or could not establish the claim.

**Evidence record detail**

Origin/collector; event date; applicable system version; claim/control/test/decision linked; reviewer/date; limitations; classification; retention owner/policy; superseding evidence.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Assemble the decision pack**

Include the system and intended use at decision time, authorization, human first pass, criteria, inputs and outputs, validation, rejected alternatives, dissent, residual risks and the named decision. Preserve documentary, operational, performance and outcome evidence as available.

**Access and maintenance**

System of record; who can read/change; version history; retention rules; review trigger; overdue requests.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Keep Client data in its approved store. Use stable references here. An AI-generated citation or a supplier assurance alone does not verify a control.
